name: mirage
text: Found the cause. The all-time number was built from this phone's own bet records, so it moves with what the phone has seen and graded. That's why it changed every time you looked. Novig's own ledger for the Vigilant subaccount is the real money: every payout and credit less every stake and fee, with open bets at cost. It currently says -$255.83 all time, across 16,508 rows. I'm making that the all-time headline, with the bets-only figure shown beside it. I'm running the tests on it now, and it ships in the next release. Daily by-ledger is next (TR3). Two other things: cash is $10 because 276 bids filled and locked money in open positions, and the 'won parlay' you saw earlier was an open quote, not a win.
